articles.title: Week 8 final call: Dallas' 31-point total and a crowded stack
articles.dek: Dallas has the slate's best stack and the field knows it. We play it, then get different in Cincinnati and the late Rams game.
tldr: Stack Prescott, Lamb and Pickens: the slate's best ceiling at 85.9 points together in our sims.
Get different with Burrow, Chase and Higgins; the market gives Cincinnati a 47% chance to win by 14+.
Fade Zay Flowers at a slate-high 28% projected ownership and move the salary to Puka Nacua.
Keep a 4 PM player in FLEX; A.J. Brown is Questionable with an 80% chance to play.

articles.title: TNF showdown: the field captains Green Bay; Carolina's upset is 26%
articles.dek: The three most popular captains are all Packers, but the market gives Carolina a 26% chance to win by 4+. McMillan and Hubbard are the way in.
tldr: Start with Tetairoa McMillan at captain: a projected 9% captain ownership, and Carolina wins by 4+ in 26% of outcomes.
Eat Jordan Love at FLEX: he projects at 68% owned, the top projection on the board at 17.8.
Fade Josh Jacobs at captain (projected 14%) for Chuba Hubbard, a 14.9-point projection at 9%.

articles.title: Week 8 first look: Dallas's 30.9-point total and the crowd chasing it
articles.dek: Dallas is the slate's best stack and the field knows it; Burrow and Lawrence offer quieter, cheaper ways to win Week 8.
tldr: Stack Prescott, Lamb and Pickens: the slate's best stack clears 75 points in 21% of sims, but expect a crowd.
Burrow, Higgins and Chase is the quieter big stack, with Burrow at just 5% projected ownership.
Lawrence, Parker Washington and Strange cost $16,700, cheap enough to add Bijan Robinson and his 20.5% optimal rate.
Fade Bhayshul Tuten at 20% projected ownership; Jaylen Warren has the higher ceiling for $700 more.

articles.title: Week 6 final read: Stafford's stack and the Bears' QB question
articles.dek: LAR's 32-point team total still leads the main slate; Chicago's QB status is the news most likely to move builds before lock.
tldr: Build around Matthew Stafford + Puka Nacua + Davante Adams: 24% of our 10,000 sims clear 75 DK points, the best rate on the slate.
Use Kirk Cousins (mid projected ownership, $5,400) with Brock Bowers and Tre Tucker as the leverage stack, p90 77.9.
Fade Patrick Mahomes at chalk: his p90 of 28.6 is eighth among QBs and costs $1,100 more than Cousins.
Caleb Williams needs news: our p_play is 35% and Sleeper lists him Out, so hold CHI exposure until it resolves.

articles.title: Week 6 first look: Rams at 32.5 and Cousins over Allen
articles.dek: The Rams' 32.5 team total anchors the slate, and the mid-owned Cousins stack clears 75 as often as the second-best Stafford build.
tldr: Stafford + Nacua + Adams clears 75 DK points in 23.6% of 10,000 sims, double any other stack, so LAR is the core.
Cousins + Bowers + Tucker clears 75 in 12.2% of sims for $17,600 with a mid-owned QB, so we build more LV than BUF.
Allen's best stack clears 75 in only 7.2% of sims, so we fade the Allen chalk and the Kincaid chalk beneath it.
Fade Mahomes and Kelce: Mahomes' p90 of 28.6 is the lowest of any chalk QB, and Daniel Jones at $5,200 beats it.
TNF is SEA by 1.9 at a 40.7 total with Jaxon Smith-Njigba's CPT p90 at 55.2, but no showdown pool is in yet.
